summary: Assembles the nested Group shape (members + foodItems + reviews + comments) that part1's AppContext expects, from batched queries.
reasoning: Deliberately returns the SAME shape as part1/src/types/index.ts rather than normalised resources, so the frontend wiring task (9khdul5b6e) is a drop-in swap with no component changes. Queries are batched by id array (WHERE x = ANY($1::uuid[])) then grouped in one pass, so adding a group or food item never adds a query — do not refactor this into per-item lookups. Likes come back as string[] of member ids via array_agg(...) FILTER, matching the frontend's Review.likes / Comment.likes.
